_doc: Durable continuous-QA queue. One entry per route×role×variant cell, merged across runs. lastSweptAt/lastResult/sweepCount/status are owned by scripts/qa-sweep.mjs; every OTHER field (depthVerifiedAt, issue, notes, owner, …) belongs to the LLM QA agent and is preserved untouched. Only a FULL sweep retires cells. This file IS committed, so keep rendered page text out of it — probe IDs and timestamps only.

admin:users.id/ADMIN/dark-1440.notes: F91 (flaky): one-off 500 on GET /admin/users/:id during the full sweep left the page on Loading user...; 37 retries (25 sequential + 12 concurrent) all 200. Watch this cell -- a 500 is never waivable, so a recurrence fails it automatically.

admin:users.id/ADMIN/light-1440.tour_last: Guidebook + token-abuse matrix (mint, reuse, tamper, wrong target)
admin:users.id/ADMIN/light-1440.notes: R2026-08-25b depth 3: clicked Impersonate on the user detail page -> the panel revealed the raw JWT with a "expires in 30 minutes / recorded in the audit log" note -> "Open impersonated session" opened a second tab that landed signed in as the target on /en/learner/dashboard (en is the target's own preferredLocale, not a leak of the admin panel locale). Audit-log claim verified against GET /admin/audit-logs: an IMPERSONATE row per mint with admin email, target email and target role. Token-abuse matrix: imp token on /admin/* 403, tampered signature 401, payload role->ADMIN swap 401, self 400, unknown id 404, other ADMIN 403, TTL exactly 30 min, deactivated target mints but is 403 on /learner/*, ?token= stripped from the URL after landing. Surfaced F94 (advisory GHSA-v8gx-9qfw-92f4): no banner, no exit control, session survives reload, and the trail records only that impersonation started.

web:locale.impersonate/ANON/ru-light-144.tour_last: Guidebook (the consumer half of the impersonation handshake)
web:locale.impersonate/ANON/ru-light-144.notes: R2026-08-25b depth 3: driven with a real minted token (?token=<jwt>) twice from fresh contexts. Consumes the token, writes it to the talim-auth store, calls /auth/me, and replaces the URL so no token survives in the address bar or history; lands on the role home. Reload keeps the session. No token -> the page renders its own error and a back-to-login link (the sweep already covers that ANON case). Contributes to F94.

web:locale.dashboard/INDIVIDUAL/uz-light.notes: Depth 2: error path driven with an API oracle (GET /content = 2 items) while the UI claimed zero. No submit yet -> NOT verified.

web:locale.quiz.id/INDIVIDUAL/uz-light-1.tour_last: Oracle tour (solve every key against the fixture) + metamorphic pair
web:locale.quiz.id/INDIVIDUAL/uz-light-1.notes: R2026-08-25b depth 3 with a real oracle, not a rendering check. Pulled the source section body from the API and graded all 5 keys of the uz-math quiz against it and docs/qa/fixtures/uz-math-facts.md: 4 of 5 quote the source verbatim and are exact; none of the fixture's trap answers (hypotenuse 7, D = b^2+4ac, intersection {1,4}, "Pythagoras discovered it first") appears. Q1 is factually right but ungrounded and mis-cited -> O101. Metamorphic pair (tight): keyed answers -> score 100, garbage -> score 0. A defensible synonym for Q1 ("90 daraja") also scored 100, so the AI judge is doing its job rather than string-matching. In the browser: retook the quiz from scratch, answered all 5, submitted, and the 100% result survived a real location.reload(); mastery moved 62 -> 73 on the same screen. Input attacks on the answer field: empty keeps Tekshirish disabled; a `<script>` payload prefixed to a correct answer is escaped (no XSS, nothing raw in the DOM) and the judge accepted the answer while telling the student not to include the script part; a missing apostrophe ("to'gri") was tolerated. Residue: 4 extra attempts on this quiz for qa-individual.

web:locale.content.id/TENANT_LEARNER/uz-.notes: Depth 3: 55-check isolation matrix over 11 content sub-resources x 5 actor/target pairs -- zero violations. Post-deactivation deep-link to the PREVIOUSLY assigned id bounces to /learner/dashboard. No cross-tenant id in any response body.

web:locale.learner.assessments/TENANT_LE.notes: Depth 3: real submissions POSTed and GRADED, verified by re-reading /learner/assessments (attemptCount persisted). maxAttempts invariant VIOLATED under concurrency -> F88, reproduced twice (2nd on a freshly created+assigned assessment). Sequential control returns 409, so the check is correct and only atomicity is missing. Also F85 error-path oracle. Test data left behind: extra GRADED attempts on QA Written Quiz! and a QA RaceProbe MaxAttempts assessment -- neither removable, see O100. GAME timing invariant also driven here: identical answers with differing self-reported timings -> 2.00x point swing, forged attempt at leaderboard rank 1 -> F89.

web:locale.learner.dashboard/TENANT_LEAR.tour_last: Multi-actor soap opera (receive, read, reply) — the other half of the tutor thread
web:locale.learner.dashboard/TENANT_LEAR.notes: Depth 3: verified under BOTH account states across real navigations. Invariant deactivated-learner-loses-access-immediately HOLDS on an already-issued token (content 200->404, /learner/materials 200->403, /learner/assessments 200->403; fresh login 403). Also CLS measured 0.19 here vs sweep 0.276 -> O98. | R2026-08-25b re-attack, messaging lens: the tutor message arrived without a reload and rendered escaped -- img onerror and script payloads shown as literal text, window.__xss never set, no raw markup in innerHTML. Bell label "Xabarlar (2 o'qilmagan)". Opening the message marked it read (unread-count 2->1 via the API) and revealed a reply box; the reply reached the tutor. Learner cannot reach any tutor messaging endpoint (403).

web:locale.quiz.id/TENANT_LEARNER/uz-lig.notes: Depth 3, KEYBOARD ONLY (Tab/Enter, no pointer): played a 3-question GAME assessment start to finish, submitted, and verified persistence after a real location.reload() -> attemptCount 3/3, latestPoints 962, and the card correctly switched to Urinishlar chekloviga yetdingiz. PASS: keyboard-operable throughout (Play 13 tabs, Start 1, first option 1), focus visible (3px outline + ring), 0/14 inputs truly unlabeled. FAIL: 0 live regions document-wide on a ticking 20s timer -> F90 (#42), same class as F83. Note the CLIENT enforces maxAttempts correctly, which supports F88 being an atomicity-only defect.

web:locale.tenant.assessments/TENANT_OWN.notes: Depth 3: created a PUBLISHED assessment from an approved bank question set and assigned it to a learner; verified it persisted by re-reading it from the LEARNER side as an assignable, submittable assessment. Surfaced O100 (no delete, no unassign, empty learnerIds rejected).

web:locale.tenant.students/TENANT_OWNER/.tour_last: Multi-actor soap opera (tutor to student and back) + input attacks on the composer
web:locale.tenant.students/TENANT_OWNER/.persona_last: Nodira (tutor) with Test Student One as the second actor
web:locale.tenant.students/TENANT_OWNER/.notes: Depth 3: opened -> clicked Faolsizlantirish on @teststudent1 -> PATCH /tenant/students/:id {active:false} -> row FAOLSIZ survived a real location.reload(). Reactivated; state restored. Surfaced F86 (#41). Seat-limit invariant also driven here (create + import + join-code paths, boundary and concurrent): sequential enforcement correct, concurrent enforcement violated -> F87, security-shaped, details in the advisory only. State restored (seatLimit -> null, probe accounts purged, over-purged fixture qa-joincode reactivated). | R2026-08-25b re-attack, messaging lens: bulk-select -> Xabar -> sent a hostile body (img onerror, script tag, RTL override, emoji, Cyrillic). Learner received it within 4.5s with no reload, rendered as TEXT (no XSS fired, no raw script/img in the DOM), bell 2 unread. Learner opened it (unread 2->1) and replied; owner bell showed 1 unread after a real reload; owner opened the thread (auto-marks student replies read), responded via the inline box with Enter, and the full 3-turn thread survived another real location.reload(). Composer input attacks: empty and whitespace-only both keep Send disabled; 5000 maxLength on both boxes. Messaging IDOR matrix 8/8 correct (cross-learner read/reply 404, learner posting to tutor endpoints 403, deactivated-only and non-member-only recipients 400). Deactivated recipients are silently dropped from a mixed selection, which is CORRECT and disclosed up front by the dialog copy ("Nofaol o'quvchilar o'tkazib yuboriladi"), so not a finding. Surfaced F93 (#45): the API accepts whitespace-only bodies on all three write paths while every composer blocks them. Also F92 (#44), the 0.289 CLS on this route. Residue: probe messages cannot be deleted (O100).

web:locale.tenant.students.id/TENANT_OWN.tour_last: Guidebook + IDOR matrix (assign round-trip, then attack the route param)
web:locale.tenant.students.id/TENANT_OWN.notes: Depth 3: opened Test Student Two (0 materials) -> clicked Biriktirish -> POST /tenant/assignments 201 -> MATERIALLAR 0->1 and the material appeared under 'Material bo'yicha progress' -> survived a real location.reload() -> API confirmed 2 assignment rows. Unassigned afterwards; state restored exactly (Test Student One's original assignedAt 2026-06-28 intact -- the upsert's empty update does not touch it). IDOR matrix 8/8 correct: foreign-student progress 404, assign-to-non-member 404, assign-to-deactivated-member 404, foreign-content assign/unassign/list 404, learner->owner route 403; no cross-tenant id in any body. 5 input attacks on the [id] param (foreign cuid, SQL-ish, XSS, 300 chars, RTL-override) all 404 with an honest '[role=alert] Yuklab bo'lmadi. Qayta urinib ko'ring.' -- this route has the error affordance the F85 routes lack, so the fix has a local precedent. Observation only (not filed, enhancement-shaped): the 'Material biriktirish' panel never shows which materials are already assigned -- it offers Biriktirish identically for an assigned and an unassigned material, and a repeat assign returns 201 Created while upserting no new row.
